metadata.description: Plugins that replay agent-evidence decision bundles and verify claims against evidence, offline

plugins.name: verdict-bundle-gate
plugins.description: Replay a verdict bundle with the pinned probity-verify after any tool names one, and block on tamper or a decision you did not allow.

plugins.name: agent-evidence
plugins.description: Verify claims about AI systems against supplied evidence and replay the agent-evidence conformance vectors, offline and read-only.
